articleTitle: Fabrication-error-tolerant, hybrid wedge plasmon polariton waveguides for ultra-deep-subwavelength mode confinement at 1550nm wavelength
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel hybrid plasmonic waveguide based on a triangular metal wedge is proposed. The structure could achieve ultra-deep-subwavelength mode confinement with low-loss, while its mode properties are still quite tolerant to fabrication errors.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s all-optical binary-to-quaternary amplitude shift keying format conversion
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 160Gb/s all-optical binary-to-quaternary amplitude shift keying format conversion is carried out in nonlinear optical fiber. This scheme, which also acts as a 2-bit digital-to-analog convertor, has been confirmed through Q-factor measurements.

articleTitle: Multi-failure post-fault restoration in multidomain DWDM networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes an adapted crankback-enabled post-fault restoration scheme against large-area failure events in multi-domain DWDM optical network. This novel solution provides recovery and resource efficiency without increasing routing overheads.

articleTitle: Optimum signal constellation design for rotationally symmetric optical channel with coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an optimum signal-constellation design (OSCD) method to obtain the optimum probabilities and mass points by split-step method. The OSCD increases channel capacity by 1.02bits/channel use after 2000 km of SMF.

articleTitle: An efficient partial link monitoring scheme for inter-domain routing under dynamic traffic scenarios
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate link-state advertising in multi-domain networks with dynamic traffic. A novel triggering scheme is proposed to monitor a subset of domain links, and thereby achieve a balance between salability and accuracy.

articleTitle: First demonstration of error-free operation of a full silicon on-chip photonic link
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report first 3-Gb/s data measurements for a photonic link including a microring modulator connected optically by a waveguide to a Germanium detector. Error-free operation is achieved with a 2-dB electrical power penalty.

articleTitle: 28-Gbaud InP square or hexagonal 16-QAM modulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic InP modulator that produces 28-Gbaud (112 Gb/s) square or hexagonal 16-QAM using four integrated amplitude/phase modulators. We achieve bit-error rates of 2.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Widely-tunable continuous-wave single-longitudinal-mode fiber optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A continuous-wave fiber optical parametric oscillator with a tunability of 114 nm, a wavelength span of 143 nm and single-longitudinal-mode oscillation is demonstrated. The short-term linewidth of the output is as narrow as 1.5 kHz.

articleTitle: Blocking performance in dynamic optical networks based on colorless, non-directional ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that blocking in dynamic networks of colorless, non-directional ROADMs is tolerant to intra-node contention when contention-aware routing/wavelength assignment (RWA) algorithms are used. An optional client-side cross-connect enables low blocking with simpler RWA variants.

articleTitle: The limits of switch bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Lane speeds need to be increased to increase switch throughput. To increase the throughput of 100 Gigabit/second (Gbps) Ethernet switches, the industry must adopt 4×25 Gbps electrical lanes over 10×10 Gbps lanes.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s short-reach transmission over 35 m large-core graded-index polymer optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In the paper we demonstrate robust 10 Gbit/s short-reach transmission over 35 m of 1-mm core-diameter graded-index polymer optical fiber with very low cost components and DMT modulation. With this scheme reliable high-speed short-reach interconnects are feasible that can be easily combined to fiber ribbons.

articleTitle: Dual pump wave generation from NRZ-ASK signal enabling a “black-box” phase sensitive amplifier
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a phase locking scheme that enables the demonstration of the first black-box dual pump degenerate phase sensitive amplifier for 10 Gbit/s NRZ-ASK signals.

articleTitle: Wide-range BER measurement scheme by estimating BER of discarded frames for 10 G-EPON systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes a new BER measurement method obtaining the BER by estimating the number of error bits in discarded frames using the rate of discarded frames. The BER is obtained precisely by the method.

articleTitle: Photonic chip based all-optical XOR gate for phase-encoded signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate error-free, no power penalty, all-optical XOR operation for 40 Gbit/s phase-encoded signals in a highly-nonlinear photonic chip. This scheme exploits the Kerr nonlinearity in a dispersion-engineered chalcogenide (As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) planar waveguide.

articleTitle: Bragg-Scattering frequency conversion in nonlinear fiber with frequency shifted feedback pumps
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally study Bragg-type frequency conversion in nonlinear fiber. We use two pumps obtained by amplifying two continuous-wave frequency-shifted feedback lasers. Our experimental results compare well with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Scaling 112 Gb/s PDM-QPSK hybrid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally and numerically determined the nonlinear transmission impairments for a hybrid PDM-QPSK/OOK network. Results are quantified via a nonlinear phase metric and can be used as design rules for scaling hybrid and other links.

articleTitle: Heuristic resource provisioning for dynamic wavelength services with access port constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper introduces a fast heuristic resource provisioning algorithm for dynamic wavelength services on agile reconfigurable ROADM networks on which customer connections are only constrained by access ports.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s REAM-SOA for low cost WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated 10.7 Gb/s REAM-SOA using simplified fabrication process. Good performance at 10.7 Gb/s was obtained with an extinction ratio of >; 9 dB and a power penalty of <; 60; 1 dB up to 20 km transmission over a 40 nm spectral range.

articleTitle: All-optical THz-band frequency multiplexing on a single optical carrier using fiber cross-phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed an ultra-broadband all-optical frequency multiplexing technique on a single optical carrier using cross-phase modulation in nonlinear fibers, and demonstrated sequentially multiplex of multi-channel Gigabit ASK/DPSK signals on THz-band.

articleTitle: Fabrication of mode field converter in H2-loaded SMF-28e using CW-Ar+ laser
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on mode field diameter changes of -231% due to UV-induced core refractive index changes of ≤10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> in SMF-28e leading to a loss reduction of 0.83 dB between SMF-28e and a dispersion compensating fiber.

articleTitle: 8-channel InP monolithic tunable optical router for packet forwarding
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Advancements in photonic integration allow development of complex, large-scale circuits suited for future optical packet switched networks. We review our 8-channel InP monolithic tunable optical router chip capable of 40 Gbps operation per port.

articleTitle: Optical systems for data centers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Building future data centers requires unprecedented internal bandwidth, at very high per-channel energy efficiency. Optics offers potential solutions for these challenges, especially if we rethink the construction of high-performance computers into compact systems-in-a-package. Here we discuss the drivers for optics in these large-scale systems.

articleTitle: Broadband ubiquitous network based on RoF-DAS over WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This report is the first demonstration of RoF-DAS over WDM-PON with TDM techniques to realize a broadband ubiquitous wireless access with a gigabit-class throughput. The optical transmission performance of RF signals is evaluated through experiments.

articleTitle: Polarization temporal signal processor for ultrahigh-speed optical communication applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-optical polarization temporal signal processor is demonstrated, which performs well in 40-Gbits/s optical signal differentiation with error of ~0.1 and efficiency of ~12%, 80-GHz 3.3-ps optical pulse generation, and reshaping for 250-fs optical pulse.

articleTitle: Suppression of SBS in a photonic crystal fiber with periodically-varied core diameter
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 7 dB improvement in Brillouin suppression in a photonic crystal fiber by periodically varying the size of the air-hole-structure by only 7% amplitude while keeping a low attenuation coefficient.

articleTitle: Photonic synthesis of triangular-shaped pulses and its tunability utilizing frequency to time mapping
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A synthesis scheme to generate microwave triangular-shaped pulses based on spectral shaping and frequency-to-time mapping is proposed. Triangular-shaped signals with periods of 0.2ns, 0.4ns, 1.6ns and pulse widths of 0.13ns, 0.35ns are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Reduction of back-reflection induced power penalty by means of coherent seeding source with optical feedback in a loop-back WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed a novel method to implement the coherent seeding source using optical feedback and experimentally demonstrated the feasibility of our seed light under various back reflection levels in a loop-back WDM-PON based on RSOA.

articleTitle: Coded modulation in optical communications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Coded modulation schemes for optical transport are reviewed and coding of 4-D constellations is discussed including iterative demapping for soft-detection of polarization-switched QPSK which achieves 1.5dB sensitivity gain compared to polarization-multiplexed QPSK.

articleTitle: A novel segment-based protection algorithm for multicast sessions in optical networks with mesh topologies
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This work examines protection of multicast sessions in optical networks utilizing a novel segment-based algorithm called Level Protection. Our proposed scheme exhibits improved performance compared to other segment-based multicast protection schemes.

PACS Terms: (060.4250) Fiber optics and optical communications, Networks

articleTitle: Low-complexity, blind phase recovery for coherent receivers using QAM modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new hybrid PLL/ML phase estimation method for low-complexity, blind phase recovery for M-QAM modulation. The linewidth tolerance of the proposed method is more than one order of magnitude better than PLL-only method.

articleTitle: Outage calculations for spatially multiplexed fiber links
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We calculate multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) outage probabilities for optical fiber links employing spatial multiplexing across linearly coupled propagation modes in the presence of mode-dependent loss and distributed optical noise.

articleTitle: VCSEL-based 100m 25Gb/s plastic optical fiber links
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report error-free performance at 25Gb/s using a directly-modulated 850nm VCSEL over 100m graded-index perfluorinated plastic optical fiber with good launch offset tolerance. Bandwidth assessment of 18 fibers demonstrates that modern POF can achieve this performance.

articleTitle: EScience applications on the SURFnet RE network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The hybrid network paradigm pioneered by SURFnet provides the capacity demanded by modern eScience applications. This contribution presents ongoing research and developments to integrate photonic networks in the application middleware stack.

articleTitle: 225 Gb/s bi-directional integrated optical PCB link
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a bidirectional optical link through polymer waveguides integrated on PCB. With 15 channels at 15 Gb/s (BER <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> and <;10 pJ/bit), the channel and aggregate bandwidths are the highest reported for waveguide interconnects.

articleTitle: Advanced fiber optic parametric synthesis and characterization
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fiber parametric mixer devices posses the highest figure of merit in any technology, allowing for superior performance with respect to gain, noise and conversion efficiency in both incoherent and coherent applications. Fiber mixers also rely on distributed, rather than lumped nonlinear interaction and require a precise, long-scale phase matching. We discuss recent advances in mapping of mixer dispersive fluctuations and corresponding means for mixer response synthesis.

articleTitle: High speed 4×12.5Gbps WDM optical wireless communication systems for indoor applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel high-speed optical wireless communication system incorporating WDM technology for indoor personal area networking applications is proposed and demonstrated. A 4×12.5Gbps mobile communication link is successfully demonstrated with error-free reception.

articleTitle: Compact, thermally-tuned resonant ring muxes in CMOS with integrated backside pyramidal etch pit
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present add-drop filters manufactured as ring resonators in commercial 130 nm SOI CMOS technology with thermal tuning. Their thermal impedance has been dramatically increased by the selective removal of the substrate resulting in a 20,12× increase in tuning efficiency for 100, 30 micron radius device.

articleTitle: Cutoff mechanisms in Bend-Insensitive Single-Mode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a comprehensive study that explains the specific mechanisms that govern the cutoff behaviors of G.657 single-trench-assisted Bend-Insensitive Single Mode Fibers (BI-SMFs) compared to those of the G.652 step-index Standard SMFs.

articleTitle: Fourier-transform, integrated-optic spatial-heterodyne spectrometer with 1 GHz resolution on a silica-based planar waveguide
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present fabrication details and measurements of a high-resolution planar-waveguide spatial heterodyne spectrometer incorporating 64 asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometers. Measurements verify 1 GHz resolution across a 64 GHz free-spectral range.

articleTitle: Optical through-hole with high aspect ratio for on-board optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed optical I/Os in packages for chip-to-chip interconnections. The I/Os of 55-μm-diameter and 1.2-mm-long optical through-holes demonstrate low loss and 10-Gb/s transmission. This package aims at future CPU systems with embedded capacitors.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive optical line checker with a leaking component embedded on an optical fiber cord
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a practical optical line checker to judge whether fiber line is live or dark without any transmission failure, achieving detectable optical signal lower limit of -40 dBm in a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: SPIDER on a chip: A phase sensitive ultrafast oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a device for full waveform characterization, exploiting FWM in a CMOS compatible photonic chip, working with pulse energies as low as 10pJ and with sub-picosecond (<;700fs) accuracy over a 100ps temporal window duration.

articleTitle: Multi data-rate synchronization of 40 GHz mode-locked quantum-dash lasers diodes
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Beat-tones at 40-GHz from a QDash-ML laser under 10 to 160 Gb/s optical injection are analyzed. A FWHM linewidth less than 8 Hz is obtained regardless of the rate of injected data stream.

articleTitle: 100G photonic integration challenges
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Photonic integration is a key enabler for 100 Gbit/sec deployments. In this talk, we will review the status of integrated components and modules for 40 G and 100 G, and also discuss the challenges for moving beyond 100 G.

articleTitle: Atacama large millimeter array local oscillator: How photonics is enabling millimeter-wave astronomy
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this talk we will describe the unique photonic technology that provides the reference for the local oscillator system of the ALMA millimeter wave radio telescope as well as describing the “down-stream” part of the local oscillator system.

articleTitle: PDL and PMD emulation with control of amplitude and spectral dependence to a sub-channel level across the C-band
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present results of a polarization diverse LCoS wavelength processor. Applications include impairment simulation of broadband, channelized and intra-band PMD and PDL for detailed experimental sensitivity analysis in dual-polarization coherent transmission.

articleTitle: High-output saturation power variable confinement slab-coupled optical waveguide amplifier
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A variable optical confinement concept was incorporated into a slab-coupled optical waveguide amplifier to increase output saturation power. This amplifier demonstrates an unsaturated gain of 21.1 dB and an output saturation power of +27.6 dBm.

articleTitle: Field trial of in-service PMD measurement using idle DWDM channels in operational long haul network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In-service PMD measurement using idle channels in an operational DWDM long-haul network is realized with two novel measurement approaches during a field trial. Accurate PMD results are obtained without impacting live network traffic.

articleTitle: Mitigation of dispersion-induced phase noise for an optical OFDM radio-over-fiber system at 60-GHz band
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For OFDM RoF systems at 60-GHz band, dispersion-induced phase noise (PN) could heavily degrade transmission performance. We propose an algorithm to suppress PN and experimentally demonstrate the algorithm can extend the transmission distance by >60%.

articleTitle: Optical networking for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The vision of the GEYSERS project is to qualify optical infrastructure providers and network operators with a new architecture and by thus enabling them to enhance their traditional business operations towards true end-to-end Cloud Computing product offerings. Optical network infrastructure providers will compose logical infrastructures and rent them out to network operators; network operators will run cost-efficient, dynamic and mission-specific networks by means of integrated control and management techniques. On top of this GEYSERS develops Cloud Computing extensions that allow high-end IT resources at users' premises to be fully integrated with the network services procedures, both at the infrastructure-planning and connection-provisioning phases. Following this vision, GEYSERS will specify and implement a novel optical-network architecture able to support `Optical Network + Any-IT' resource provisioning seamlessly and efficiently and by thus conceive a true end-to-end Cloud Computing Infrastructure-as-a-Service framework that ranges beyond contemporary data-center confined Cloud Computing frameworks.

articleTitle: Low loss microstructured polymer optical fibre (mPOF)
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a high tension draw we produced a fibre with a loss of 0.16 dB/m at 650nm, making mPOF competitive for the first time with conventional POF. Annealing increases thermal stability.

articleTitle: Hardware requirements for optical circuit switched data center networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Based on measurements of a prototype, we identify hardware requirements for improving the performance of hybrid electrical-packet-switched/optical-circuit-switched data center networks.

articleTitle: A novel scheme for seamless integration of ROF system with OFDM-CPM WDM passive optical network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel scheme to generate, transmit and receive an optical OFDM-CPM signal in the architecture for seamless integration of ROF system with 4 × 2.5Gb/s WDM-PON is proposed and experimentally validated.

articleTitle: All-optical self-synchronizing scheme for contention resolution in asynchronous optical packet switched networks using continuously tunable optical delay line
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Continuously tunable, optically-controlled variable delay line based on dynamic Brillouin grating is exploited for automated synchronization of switching signals in a network node, enabling asynchronous contention resolution with packet priorization.

articleTitle: Maximum reach of long-reach RSOA-based WDM PON employing remote EDFA
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the effects of the gain and position of the remote EDFA in a long-reach RSOA-based WDM PON. Using this result, we also estimate the maximum transmission reach limited by Rayleigh backscattering.

articleTitle: Techno-economic analysis of a dynamic impairment-aware optical network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We quantify the performance of impairment-aware networking in terms of capital and operational expenditures and compare it to an impairment-unaware solution in the presence of nodes that bear different degrees of flexibility.

articleTitle: Performance prediction for WDM PM-QPSK transmission over uncompensated links
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We derive closed-form expressions depending on a single fitting parameter for performance prediction of WDM PM-QPSK long-haul uncompensated transmission. Besides general properties, we demonstrate that nonlinear penalty is always equal to 1.76 dB.

articleTitle: Optical packet and circuit simultaneous transmission technologies for dynamic lightpath setup/release and packet traffic change
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For dynamic traffic change on packet/lightpath integration, all-bandwidth amplifiers and high dynamic-range packet receivers are developed. 80-Gbit/s colored optical packets and 8-lightpaths simultaneous 170-km field transmission are demonstrated.

articleTitle: RFoG - Foggy, or real?
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: RFoG is a third type of PON, after EPON and GPON. It is specific for cable TV, and is designed to facilitate an orderly transition from HFC to PON architectures while maintaining existing systems.

publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: •Cost-effective Integration of Optical and Wireless Networks -Lowcost & high performance RF-over-Fiberlinks compatible with digital optical networks •Provided an overview of: -Digitized RF over fibre. -Digital I-Q over FiberTrasmission

articleTitle: Scaling networks in large data centers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Summary form only given. Large data centers continue to push the limits of conventional networking. This talk discusses cluster computing, fat-tree topologies, novel routing techniques, higher-speed links, optical building blocks, and future designs.

articleTitle: Power consumption in hybrid access and home networking network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare energy consumptions of access and home networks for GPON, DOCSIS 3.0, GPON EOC, and indoor extensions of POF, HomePNA, PLC, and WiMax. Combined GPON EOC and POF technologies provide the most energy-efficient solutions.

articleTitle: Demonstration of mode-division multiplexing transmission over 10 km two-mode fiber with mode coupler
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We realized mode-division multiplexing(MDM) transmission by using orthogonal LP modes with negligible modal crosstalk, for the first time. A 2×10Gbps MDM transmission was achieved over a 10km two-mode fiber with sufficiently low power penalty.

articleTitle: Defragmentation of transparent Flexible optical WDM (FWDM) networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce the network defragmentation problem for FWDM networks, formulate it, and propose heuristics. The network defragmentation process consolidates the available spectrum significantly while minimizing the number of interrupted connections.

articleTitle: Traffic types and growth in backbone networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the growth of the different sources of data traffic on backbones, highlight the importance and nature of IP services today, and discuss the implications on content distribution and efficient use of backbone capacity.

articleTitle: Dynamic routing and spectrum assignment in flexible optical path networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose dynamic routing and spectrum assignment algorithms for bitrate-flexible lightpaths in OFDM-based optical networks. The novel algorithms enable dynamic spectrum assignment with more efficient resource utilization and less traffic blockings.

articleTitle: Survivable transparent Flexible optical WDM (FWDM) networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an efficient survivable FWDM network design algorithm for the first time. Survivable FWDM networks are efficient in terms of spectral utilization, power consumption, and cost compared to the conventional survivable fixed grid networks.

articleTitle: 803 Mbit/s visible light WDM link based on DMT modulation of a single RGB LED luminary
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the first visible light link based on WDM and DMT modulation of a single RGB-type white LED, operating at an aggregate rate of 803 Mbit/s within the FEC 2·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> limit.

articleTitle: The emerging optical data center
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the architecture of modern datacenter networks, as well as their scaling challenges; then present high-level requirements for deploying optical technologies in datacenters, particularly focusing on optical circuit switching and WDM transceivers.

articleTitle: Space-division multiplexing over 10 km of three-mode fiber using coherent 6 × 6 MIMO processing
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the transmission of 6 independent, spatially- and polarization multiplexed 28-Gb/s QPSK signals over 10 km of three-mode fiber using mode-selective excitation and full coherent 6 × 6 MIMO processing.

articleTitle: 44 Gb/s VCSEL for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Highly temperature-stable, high-speed 980-nm VCSELs for optical interconnects are presented. Error-free performance up to 44 Gb/s at 25°C and 38 Gb/s at 85°C is demonstrated. These are the highest data-rates for VCSELs reported to date.

articleTitle: Multi-channel coherent PM-QPSK InP transmitter photonic integrated circuit (PIC) operating at 112 Gb/s per wavelength
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10-wavelength, polarization-multiplexed, monolithically integrated InP transmitter PIC is demonstrated for the first time to operate at 112 Gb/s per wavelength with a coherent receiver PIC.

articleTitle: Stable self-seeding of R-SOAs for WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Self-seeding of R-SOAs is a polarization dependent process resulting in unstable operations. We experimentally demonstrate a passive stabilization technique enabling class carrier availability in 1.25 Gb/s WDM-PONs.

articleTitle: Application-aware aggregation and traffic engineering in a converged packet-circuit network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a converged OpenFlow enabled packet-circuit network, where circuit flow properties (guarantee d bandwidth, low latency, low jitter, bandwidth-on-demand, fast recovery) provide differential treatment to dynamically aggregated packet flows for voice, video and web traffic.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a gridless multi-granular optical network supporting flexible spectrum switching
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A gridless dynamic multi-granular optical network supporting flexible spectrum allocation is proposed and experimentally demonstrated to efficiently accommodate high-speed traffic and increase channel density for lower speed traffic leading to improved network efficiency and scalability.

articleTitle: 101.7-Tb/s (370×294-Gb/s) PDM-128QAM-OFDM transmission over 3×55-km SSMF using pilot-based phase noise mitigation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Record capacity transmission of 101.7-Tb/s (370×294-Gb/s) is performed over 3×55 km SSMF using PDM-128QAM-OFDM modulation and pilot-based phase noise mitigation. Achieved spectral efficiency of 11 bits/s/Hz is the highest reported to date for WDM transmission.

articleTitle: Energy efficient content distribution for VoD services
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The energy consumption of VoD services arising from storage and transport of video contents stored in different content placement locations is investigated. Our results provide insight into content placement strategies that improve energy efficiency.

articleTitle: MPLS with a simple OPEN control plane
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new approach to MPLS that uses the standard MPLS data plane and an OpenFlow based simpler and extensible control plane. We demonstrate this approach using a prototype system for MPLS Traffic Engineering.

articleTitle: Generation of 5-Gbps QPSK signal using directly modulated RSOA for 100-km coherent WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We generate the QPSK signal by utilizing the chirp characteristics of the directly modulated RSOA for the high-speed coherent WDM PON. In addition, we demonstrate the error-free transmission of the 5-Gbps QPSK signal generated by using this technique over 100-km long fiber link without using any optical amplifiers and electronic equalizers.

articleTitle: 64/32/16QAM-OFDM using direct-detection for 40G-OFDMA-PON downstream
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 43.6Gb/s downstream OFDMA-PON is demonstrated using optical single-side band 64/32/16QAMOFDM signals and direct-detection receiver through 20km SSMF. Only one photodiode/OFDM receiver is required at the ONU, thereby significantly reducing system implementation complexity and cost.

articleTitle: Cost-efficiency of mixed 10-40-100Gb/s networks and elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the cost-efficiency of optical networks based on mixed datarates (10, 40, 100Gb/s) and elastic technologies. We show elastic network bring up to 37% lower cost, in particular for high loads and dynamic scenarios.

articleTitle: Future bandwidth demand favors TDM PON, not WDM PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Claims to the contrary notwithstanding, quantitative trends indicate that TDM PON bandwidth supply is growing faster than subscriber bandwidth demand, and TDM PON will deliver future ultra-high speed services far more efficiently than WDM PON.

articleTitle: Bidirectional 10 Gbit/s long-reach WDM-PON using digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Bidirectional transmission at 10 Gbit/s using 3.125 GBaud PDM-QPSK over 100 km of SMF is investigated. We observe no penalty for transmission of 10 GHz spaced channels. Preamplification improves the receiver sensitivity from -45.9 dBm to -53.0 dBm.

articleTitle: Symmetric 10G-EPON ONU burst-mode transceiver employing dynamic power save control circuit
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Symmetric 10G-EPON ONU burst-mode transceiver employing dynamic power save control circuit was, for the first time, developed. Reduction of power consumption up to 37.7% was successfully achieved with shorter settling time of 736 ns.

articleTitle: 20 Tbit/s capacity transmission over 6,860 km
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We transmit 198×100G pre-filtered PDM-RZ-QPSK channels with 400% spectral efficiency over 6,860 km. We also show that 100G coherent nonlinear performance scales differently with distance on uncompensated dispersion maps than expected from direct-detection transmission.

articleTitle: Bi-directionally amplified extended reach 40Gb/s CWDM-TDM PON with burst-mode upstream transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 60-km CWDM-TDM PON with 40 Gb/s capacity both down and upstream. The system incorporates technologies such as volume manufacturable transmitters, burst-mode transmission, hybrid SOA-Raman amplifiers, and a cyclic CWDM multiplexer.

articleTitle: Equalization and pre-distorted schemes for increasing data rate in in-door visible light communication system
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate using signal pre-distortion and equalization schemes for increasing the data rate of the white-light LED communication system. Bit-error-rate of <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> at 10-Mb/s operation was achieve using 1-MHz bandwidth white-light LED.

articleTitle: Reception of mode and polarization multiplexed 107-Gb/s CO-OFDM signal over a two-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a method of LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub>/LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> dual-mode and dual-polarization coherent OFDM detection at 107 Gb/s. Successful reception is achieved over a 4.5-km two-mode fiber with a grating-based mode converter as a mode-selective element.

articleTitle: 109-Tb/s (7×97×172-Gb/s SDM/WDM/PDM) QPSK transmission through 16.8-km homogeneous multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate record 109-Tb/s transmission of spatial division multiplexed (SDM) signals over 16.8 km using a seven-core fiber. Each SDM channel contains 97 WDM channels on a 100-GHz grid and 2×86-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Wavelength selective switching with one-chip silicon photonic circuit including 8 × 8 matrix switch
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarization-independent wavelength path switching is demonstrated with one-chip silicon photonic circuit including 64 thermo-optical switch elements within 12mm × 3mm. Owing to uniformity, any path can be constructed by simply turning on one switch element.

articleTitle: Optimization of 16-point ring constellations in the presence of nonlinear phase noise
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The optimum radius distribution in terms of the average symbol error rate (SER) for different 16-point signal sets is derived numerically for a fiber channel limited by nonlinear phase noise. The results show up to 2.4 dB performance improvement.

articleTitle: Comparison of energy consumption of integrated optical-wireless access networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A comparison of energy consumption of an integrated optical-wireless network with different wireless signal transport schemes is investigated. The results indicate that digitized RF/IF-over-fiber schemes are the most energy-efficient for integrated optical-wireless access networks while baseband-over-fiber scheme consumes the most energy.

articleTitle: Current and next-generation broadband access technologies
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: low-cost tunable laser diodes; (sub $1000) low-cost tunable filters; low-cost integrated amplifier technologies; athermal active; passive optical components; photonic integrated circuits; advanced digital signal processing.

articleTitle: Drivers and applications of optical technologies for Internet Data Center networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The rise of large-scale Data Centers to power the Internet infrastructure is driving new architectural directions for optical networking. This paper highlights these architectural options and discusses technology building blocks for scaling inter-Datacenter connectivity.

articleTitle: 31 Gbps RoF system employing adaptive bit-loading OFDM modulation at 60 GHz
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Record wireless data transmission of 31.4 Gbps within 7 GHz license-free band at 60 GHz is experimentally demonstrated using adaptive bit-loading OFDM modulation. Adaptive bit-loading OFDM also enables extended fiber transmission distances beyond 5km.

articleTitle: Performance of optical Fast-OFDM in MMF-based links
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 19.375Gb/s optical Fast-OFDM signals can be transmitted over 500 m worst-case MMF DML-based links having 3-dB effective bandwidths of 150 MHz.km. This performance is similar to that corresponding to a conventional OFDM having twice the bandwidth.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of adaptive bit and/or power loading for maximising real-time end-to-end optical OFDM transmission performance
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time adaptive bit and/or power loading of real-time, end-to-end optical OFDM transceivers are experimentally demonstrated and compared. Low-complexity power loading only results in a penalty of ~7% compared to high-complexity bit-power-loading.

articleTitle: A novel optical burst ring network with optical-layer aggregation and flexible bandwidth provisioning
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel optical burst ring network is proposed by employing fixed-tuned transmitters rather than fast tunable lasers. All-optical traffic aggregation/bypass at network nodes significantly reduces the network cost, and both wavelength and dynamically-adjusted sub-wavelength granularity can be flexibly provisioned on the optical layer.

articleTitle: On the interest of chirped lasers for AMOOFDM transmissions in long distance PON networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the performance of a chirped laser in IMDD-based transmissions and we show that the interplay between laser chirp and fiber dispersion can be very attractive for long distance PONs if adaptive OFDM modulation is used.

articleTitle: 50 fJ-per-bit, high speed, directly modulated light sources for on-chip optical data communications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By employing optical injection-locking the direct modulation bandwidth of a 10μm diameter disc laser is increased to 15GHz. In addition, modulation at 20Gb/s is demonstrated with only 1mW DC bias & 190mV data signals (50fJ/bit).

articleTitle: Multi-failure restoration demonstrations with multi-vendor interoperability in control plane enabled WSON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate multi-failure restoration in optical layer by using an eleven-node multi- vendor WSON test-bed. Automatic restoration is achieved by deploying colorless and directionless optical switching equipments with WSON-enabled control plane.

articleTitle: 1.2 Tb/s symmetric WDM-OFDMA-PON over 90km straight SSMF and 1∶32 passive split with digitally-selective ONUs and coherent receiver OLT
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Record 1.2-Tb/s (25λ×48Gb/s/λ) symmetric WDM-OFDMA-PON is demonstrated over 90km SSMF with a 1:32 passive split, featuring multi-band-OFDMA, digitally-selective ONUs and a coherent receiver OLT. The architecture supports 800 ONUs with 1.25/10-Gb/s guaranteed/peak rates.

articleTitle: Nano-second response, polarization insensitive and low-power consumption PLZT 4×4 matrix optical switch
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A strictly non-blocking PLZT 4×4 optical switch with less than 10 ns response is developed. The switch consisted of 24-1×2 switch elements which have polarization insensitivity and low-power consumption is integrated on a single chip.

articleTitle: High-performance low-loss Silicon-on-Insulator microring resonators using TM-polarized light
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Microring resonators on SOI are investigated for both orthogonal polarizations. By demonstrating low-loss (1.94dB/cm) microring resonators with an intrinsic Q up to 340000 we proof that using TM-polarized light enables high-performance filters.

articleTitle: OTN to enable flexible networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Flexible networks are critical when it comes to maximizing utilization of high capacity wavelengths. OTN switching either separate from or integrated with DWDM provides the flexibility for increasing utilization. Further, OTN switches enable traffic re-grooming as the network grows and evolves to maintain high levels of utilization.

articleTitle: Ultra-low-crosstalk multi-core fiber feasible to ultra-long-haul transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Inter-core crosstalk of fabricated multi-core fiber was statistically evaluated to be less than -77.6 dB after 17.4-km propagation for λ=1550 nm using newly-developed method. The crosstalk was estimated to be less than -30 dB after 10,000 km.

articleTitle: Computationally-efficient DSP-based MIMO equalization for OSNR gains in 40Gb/s OFDMA-PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present and experimentally verify a novel computationally-efficient MIMO equalization method in 40Gb/s OFDMA-PON with polarization multiplexing and direct detection. A 2.1dB DSP-based OSNR gain is achieved over 20km SSMF plus 1∶32 optical split.

articleTitle: Transmission of multi-band OFDM-UWB signals along NG-FTTH networks using directly modulated lasers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transmission of multi-band OFDM-UWB signals along FTTH networks using directly modulated lasers is experimentally evaluated. Reach of 100 km of standard SMF is achieved with a BER below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> and an OSNR of 25 dB.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a coherent UDWDM-PON with real-time processing
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A filterless coherent PON with channel spacing down to 2.8 GHz and real-time processing in an FPGA is demonstrated. 64-channel operation is verified experimentally using SSB generation at the OLT and fully integrated ONU transceivers.

articleTitle: 1-Tb/s large girth LDPC-coded coherent optical OFDM transmission over 1040-km standard single-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 1-Tb/s CO-OFDM transmission over 1040-km standard single-mode fiber using 50% overhead girth-12 LDPC-coded 16-QAM. More than 4-dB improvement in OSNR sensitivity is achieved over conventional 4-QAM while maintaining the same spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Impact of fiber parameters on nonlinear fiber capacity
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the impact of varying the fiber loss and nonlinear coefficients and the chromatic dispersion on the nonlinear capacity limit estimates of fibers. The results suggest that a relative change in fiber loss or nonlinear coefficients have greater impact on the fiber nonlinear capacity limit estimate than a similar relative change in chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: 2.1-Tb/s·km OFDM long-reach PON transmission using a cost-effective electro-absorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a superior performance of 2.1-Tb/s·km OFDM-signal transmission over 100-km long-reach PONs, which is achieved by using an EAM and direct-detection, and adopting the 128-QAM format and adaptive subcarrier power weighting.

articleTitle: Up to 40Gb/s optically amplified AMOOFDM for next generation PON networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the performances of IMDD AMOOFDM transmissions in both amplified and unamplified configurations for long distance PON networks with 1∶32 and 1∶64 split ratios. Up to 40Gb/s bit rate has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Persistent channel power deviations in constant gain amplified long-chain ROADM networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Numerical simulations of the evolution of the channel power response to power adjustments in constant gain amplified degree-2 ROADM networks demonstrate novel persistent and periodic distant-dependent power deviation patterns.

articleTitle: Frequency conversion of mid-infrared optical signals into the telecom band using nonlinear silicon nanophotonic wires
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate parametric conversion with simultaneous 19.5 dB amplification, of a mid-IR 2440 nm signal to the telecom-band near 1620 nm, using silicon nanophotonic wires. Conversion over 820 nm is facilitated using higher-order waveguide dispersion.

articleTitle: 1 THz-bandwidth optical comb generation using Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator with optical feedback loop
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated broadband comb generation using a Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator with an optical feedback loop. A 1 THz-width comb signal was successfully generated by increment of the modulation depth.

articleTitle: Optimized multi-layer optical network using in-service ODU / wavelength path re-grooming
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a multi-layer network with in-service traffic re-grooming. The combination of colorless multi-degree ROADM and ODU cross-connect with ODU reallocation functionality can offer significant cost reduction with no impact of re-grooming on services.

articleTitle: 20 Gb/s WDM-PON system with 1 GHz RSOA using partial response equalization and optical filter detuning
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report high speed operation in WDM-PON with low-bandwidth RSOA using partial response equalization and optical filter detuning techniques. 20 Gb/s transmission over 10 km fiber is demonstrated with good performance using only 1-GHz-bandwidth RSOA.

articleTitle: Reduction of crosstalk by trench-assisted multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Trench-assisted multi-core fiber (TA-MCF) is proposed to achieve high dense MCF design with a solid structure. The crosstalk value at 1.55 μm of fabricated TA-MCF is estimated to be -35 dB at 100 km.

articleTitle: Transmission at 2×100Gb/s, over two modes of 40km-long prototype few-mode fiber, using LCOS-based mode multiplexer and demultiplexer
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We transmit two 100Gb/s PDM-QPSK data streams over two different modes of a 40km-long prototype few-mode fiber. Our experiment is performed with an LCOS-based mode multiplexer/demultiplexer and 4×4 MIMO algorithm in a coherent receiver.

articleTitle: Constant envelope optical OFDM for improved nonlinear and phase noise tolerance
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce a new concept of OFDM transmission with constant envelope and coherent detection to reduce the sensitivity of OFDM signals to nonlinear effects and phase noise.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a symmetrical 10/10 Gbit/s XG-PON2 system
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: Adriaan J. de Lind van Wijngaarden

abstract: Full system demonstration of a FSAN XG-PON2 system, which integrates the medium access control and physical layer incorporating 10 Gbit/s burst mode upstream transmission. A specific challenge addressed was the hardware design of the FEC.

articleTitle: 100-km uplink transmission of 10G- and 1G-ONU co-existing TDM-OCDMA-PON system using dual-rate burst-mode receiver
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In a cost-effective TDM-OCDMA-PON system without en/decoder at each ONU, the uplink dispersion-compensation-free 10 Gbps/1 Gbps-co-existing TDM × 4-OCDMA transmission over 100 km SMF is demonstrated by adopting 10G/1G dual-rate burst-mode receiver.

articleTitle: 30Gbit/s 3 × 3 optical Mode Group Division Multiplexing system with Mode-Selective Spatial Filtering
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: A 30Gbit/s 3 × 3 optical Mode Group Division Multiplexing system with Mode-Selective Spatial Filtering (MSSF) using single-mode fiber is demonstrated over 20m graded-index multimode fiber. Crosstalk among the mode groups is minimized through MSSF.

articleTitle: Ultra-low power arrayed CMOS silicon photonic transceivers for an 80 Gbps WDM optical link
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report an ultra-low power 80 Gbps arrayed silicon photonic transceiver for dense, large bandwidth inter/intra-chip interconnects. The hybrid CMOS transceiver consists of eight 10 Gbps WDM channels with total consumed power below 6 mW/channel.

articleTitle: A novel dispersion and PMD tolerant clock phase detector for coherent transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel clock phase detector is presented and shown to be tolerant to chromatic dispersion and PMD. The phase detector can be used in a clock recovery circuit for demodulation of 100 Gb/s coherent transmission system.

articleTitle: Field experiment with mixed line-rate transmission (112-Gb/s, 450-Gb/s, and 1.15-Tb/s) over 3,560 km of installed fiber using filterless coherent receiver and EDFAs only
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First field experiment with mixed line-rate transmission of 100-Gb/s, 450-Gb/s, and 1.15-Tb/s performed over record distance of 3,560 km field fiber with EDFAs only. Results prove increasing capacity and efficiency is possible without sacrificing reach.

articleTitle: Multilevel optical modulator with PLC and LiNbO3 hybrid integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical modulators with a hybrid configuration of silica-PLCs and LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> phase modulators are promising for advanced multilevel modulation formats. Modulators for OFDM-QPSK, 64QAM, and a selectable format have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-speed modulation lasers for 100GbE applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the performance of 1.3-μm InGaAlAs RWG-MQW-DFB lasers and EA-DFB lasers applicable to 40G/100G Ethernet. We obtained a 3-dB-down bandwidth frequency of over 30 GHz and clear eye opening at a 40-Gb/s modulation speed.

articleTitle: Linearized parametric gate for real-time photonic-sampled analog-to-digital conversion
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A linearized parametric sampling gate was constructed to explore its performance limits in an analog-to-digital conversion (ADC) architecture. Linear response of the sampling gate can be achieved both in high-resolution and high-rate ADC.

articleTitle: 40-Gbps transmission using direct modulation of 1.3-µm AlGaInAs MQW distributed-reflector lasers up to 70°C
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 40-Gbps transmission over 5-km single-mode fiber using a directly modulated 1.3-μm AlGaInAs MQW distributed-reflector laser was demonstrated. Error-free operations up to 70°C have been achieved.

articleTitle: 300 Mbps transmission with 4.6 bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency over 50 m PMMA POF link using RC-LED and multilevel Carrierless Amplitude Phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Successful transmission of up to 300 Mbps over a 50 m long POF link using a commercially available Fast Ethernet capable RC-LED is presented. Carrierless Amplitude Phase modulation was used with 16- and 64-point constellations.

articleTitle: Less than 0.19-dB transient gain excursion AGC-EDFA with digital control for 20-channel add/drop equivalent operation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a digitally controlled AGC-EDFA by combining an FF-controlled pump-LD and an FB-controlled VOA. An FPGA is used to finely tune the gain setting of the pump current with a wide dynamic range for input burst signals and to precisely configure the gain and cutoff bandwidth for the loop control of the VOA. We realized a gain excursion of less than 0.19 dB at the AGC-EDFA with the VOA for a 20-channel add/drop equivalent operation. We believe 0.19 dB to be the smallest value yet reported.

articleTitle: Implementation efficient nonlinear equalizer based on correlated digital backpropagation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: One stage per span is commonly considered as the lower boundary for implementation complexity of nonlinear equalizer based on digital backpropagation. The proposed method overcomes this boundary and improves the efficiency by about four times.

articleTitle: CAPEX savings by a scalable IP Offloading approach
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper shows the CAPEX benefits of an IP over reconfigurable WDM network architecture, which combines most of the benefits of IP Offloading theory while entailing a minimal impact in current IP core networks design.

articleTitle: 100Gb/s dual-carrier DP-QPSK performance after WDM transmission including 50GHz wavelength selective switches
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a real-time intradyne receiver, we characterize the tolerance of a 100 Gb/s dual-carrier dual-polarization-QPSK signal to carrier frequency separation and frequency offset after WDM transmission over 9·100 km standard single-mode fiber and ten wavelength selective switches.

articleTitle: Field demonstration of Bi-directional millimeter wave RoF systems inter-operable with 60 GHz multi-gigabit CMOS transceivers for in-building HD video and data delivery
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, a bi-directional in-building radio-over-fiber access network to deliver multi-gigabit, high-definition video and data services using all-optical conversion at the head-end and single-chip, 60GHz CMOS radio transceiver at the end-terminals.

articleTitle: Compact InGaAsP/InP flattened ring lasers with etched beam splitters
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present results from novel compact InGaAsP/InP based flattened micro-ring resonators and lasers. Resonators with circumferences 30-300μm by using etched beam-splitters (EBS) are demonstrated. EBS coupler insertion loss is measured as low as 0.6dB.

articleTitle: Generation, transmission and coherent detection of 11.2 Tb/s (112×100Gb/s) single source optical OFDM superchannel
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel scheme to generate coherent 112 optical sub-carriers with subcarrier spacing of 25 GHz is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. By using these coherent optical subcarriers, we have successfully generated 10-Tbit/s (112×100 Gbit/s) single channel optical OFDM polarization multiplexing QPSK signal with the bandwidth of 2.8 THz and the optical signal noise ratio greater than 20 dB (0.1nm bandwidth for each subchannel). We have transmitted the 11.2-Tbit/s optical OFDM signal over 640-km SMF-28 with an amplifier span of 80 km and EDFA-only.

articleTitle: Energy efficient grooming of scheduled sub-wavelength traffic demands
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate how awareness of demand holding times can be exploited for energy efficient traffic grooming in optical networks. We present an optimal formulation for minimizing the energy consumption of a set of scheduled demands.

articleTitle: Modulation and chirp characterization of a 100-GHz EO polymer Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally characterize a 100-GHz polymer Mach-Zehnder modulator including its frequency chirp response and broadband data modulation. BER performance is achieved at 80 Gbit/s for DPSK and >;90 Gbit/s for OOK. Tunable chirp operation is demonstrated while eye diagrams at 100 Gbit/s and 110-GHz S21 measurements further demonstrate the >; 100-GHz response.

articleTitle: 10 Channel, 100Gbit/s per channel, dual polarization, coherent QPSK, monolithic InP receiver photonic integrated circuit
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10 channel, dual polarization, monolithically integrated, coherent QPSK receiver on InP operating at 100 Gbit/s per channel is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 1.3-µm, 50-Gbit/s EADFB lasers for 400GbE
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed 1.3-μm, 50-Gbit/s EADFB lasers for future 400Gbit Ethernet. 10-and 40-km SMF transmission with clear eye openings over 14-nm wavelength range under 50-Gbit/s operation are demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Realistic approaches to scaling the IP network using optics
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the relative cost and complexity of network architectures that reduce the cost of the IP layer over DWDM. We conclude that a combination of IPoDWDM and flexible spectrum provide the most promising direction.

articleTitle: OFDM for next generation optical access networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: Optical OFDM; OFDMA-PON principles and benefits; recent advances in high-speed OFDMA-PON; DSP requirements for OFDMA-PON.

articleTitle: Green and high-power photonic millimeter-wave (MMW) generator for remote generation at 124-GHz
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By combing high-modulation-depth (160%) photonic 124GHz MMW sources with NBUTC-PDs for remote (>;25km) generation, 6dB power enhancements and 14.4dBm saturation power are achieved as compared to NBUTC-PDs operated under sinusoidal excitation.

articleTitle: All-optical OOK to 16QAM modulation format conversion employing nonlinear optical fiber loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel all-optical modulation format conversion scheme from on-off-keying to 16 quadrature amplitude modulation using nonlinear optical loop mirror based on parametric amplification and cross-phase modulation in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Enabling components for future high-speed coherent communication systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Next-generation high-speed coherent optical communication systems targeting beyond 100-Gb/s per channel, have opened opportunities for innovations in component and subsystem areas that this tutorial will attempt to address, covering photonics, electronics and signal processing technologies.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tolerance of 112-Gb/s DP-QPSK in a live field upgrade trial over a 848km 10G DWDM link
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An in-service field trial with coherently detected DP-QPSK at 112 Gb/s was performed over a Telefónica live link of 848km, testing long term stability and determining noise margin and optimum launch power of the format.

articleTitle: Seamless access router upgrades through IP/optical integration
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe RFC, a new capability that minimizes customer outages during software and hardware upgrades in ISP networks. RFC is being used by a large Tier-1 ISP to upgrade access routers supporting thousands of customers.

articleTitle: Dynamic routing and frequency slot assignment for elastic optical path networks that adopt distance adaptive modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a dynamic routing and frequency slot assignment algorithm for SLICE networks that employ distance adaptive modulation. We verify that the spectrum utilization penalty that stems from non-uniform bandwidth allocation is marginal.

articleTitle: 8 450-Gb/s, 50-GHz-spaced, PDM-32QAM transmission over 400km and one 50GHz-grid ROADM
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Employing Nyquist-pulse-shaped PDM-32QAM modulation and both pre- and post-transmission digital equalization, we demonstrate 50GHz-spaced, 8×450Gbits/s DWDM transmission over 4 100km of ultra-large-area fiber and one 50GHz-grid WSS-based ROADM at 8.37b/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: 3 × 485-Gb/s WDM transmission over 4800 km of ULAF and 12 × 100-GHz WSSs using CO-OFDM and single coherent detection with 80-GS/s ADCs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate WDM transmission of three 485-Gb/s CO-OFDM channels with 16-QAM subcarrier-modulation, each received by a single coherent detection step. Transmission over 48 100-km ULAF spans and 12 wavelength-selective-switches with 4-b/s/Hz net spectral-efficiency is achieved.

articleTitle: A low complexity pre-distortion method for intra-channel nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a low complexity intra-channel nonlinearity pre-distortion method based on symbol rate operation. The method is experimentally verified under a 43Gb/s DP-QPSK coherent system, and the performance is comparable with back-propagation method.

articleTitle: (O)FDMA PON over a legacy 30dB ODN
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A reflective polarization independent carrier suppressed optical modulation system for FDMA/OFDMA PON over legacy infrastructures is proposed. A demonstrator is experimentally validated as an initial step towards full multi-user functionality.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s modulation of Reflective SOA without any electronic processing
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, we demonstrate that the use of a long RSOA as remote modulator enables short distance transmission on SMF below the FEC limit at 10 Gbit/s without any electronic processing.

articleTitle: An SoC demonstration of ONU discovery and dynamic bandwidth allocation for 10G/1G dual-rate 10G-EPON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Newly developed dual-rate OLT and ONU SoCs combined with our latest transceivers demonstrate high efficient 10G/1G ONU simultaneous discovery processing and hardware-accelerated dynamic bandwidth allocation of the transmission time according to the requirements.

articleTitle: Progress in high-responsivity vertical-illumination type Ge-on-Si photodetecor operating at λ ∼1.55 µm
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a vertical-illumination-type 100% Ge-on-Si photodetector with the responsivity up to 0.93 A/W at λ∼1.55 µm. The 10Gbps photoreceiver with a fabricated 60 µm-diameter device exhibits high sensitivity of −19.5 dBm for λ∜1.55 µm.

articleTitle: Low cost, injection molded 120 Gbps optical backplane
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A low cost, blind mate, injection molded optical backplane is presented. The optical backplane consists of a 12 channel optical broadcast bus operating at 10Gbps/channel with six blind mate optical output ports spaced 1U apart.

articleTitle: OTM- and OTDR-based cost-efficient fiber fault identification and localization in Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: PON monitoring based on combined Optical Time Domain Reflectometry (OTDR) and Optical Transceiver Monitoring (OTM) is presented. The results on a 25-km 1:32 PON prove the concept and show ~0.02 dB accuracy with theoretical values.

articleTitle: Realization of a 23.9 Gb/s real time optical-OFDM transmitter with a 1024 point IFFT
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
