abstract: Transmitter equalization enables dramatic improvements in total link performance: >; 6 dB in sensitivity, 3X in timing margin, and 2X in power efficiency at 15 Gb/s, and a record 5.7 pJ/bit at 20 Gb/s.

articleTitle: High power monolithic all-fiber counter-propagating pumped single-frequency amplifier
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a monolithic all-fiber, counter-propagating pumped, single-frequency amplifier with an output power of 47 W.

articleTitle: 80-Gbit/s DQPSK optical tapped-delay-line equalization using finely tunable delays, phases and amplitudes
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a tunable and reconfigurable optical tapped delay line using conversion dispersion based delays with optical multicasting and multiplexing. After equalization, at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> and 3 dB power penalty, dispersion tolerance is improved by >;50% and 200% for 80-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK and 40-Gbit/s RZ-DPSK signals, respectively.

articleTitle: Hybrid 224-Gb/s and 112-Gb/s PDM-QPSK transmission at 50-GHz channel spacing over 1200-km dispersion-managed LEAF® spans and 3 ROADMs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We transmit a mix of 224-Gb/s and 112-Gb/s PDM-QPSK channels at a 50-GHz spacing and 3-b/s/Hz spectral efficiency over 1200-km dispersion-managed LEAF<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> spans with 3 ROADMs and over 2000 km without ROADMs.

articleTitle: Optical network design algorithms that consider optical path add/drop ratio restrictions for OXC hardware scale reduction
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We develop network design algorithms that consider constraints on the number of added/dropped optical paths at nodes in terms of wavelength and of fiber. The strategy is demonstrated to significantly reduce node hardware scale.

articleTitle: Dynamic range enhancement in reflectometry by synthesis of optical coherence function with half-wave intensity modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Half-wave intensity modulation is proposed for apodization in synthesis of optical coherence function to suppress side-lobes around synthesized delta-function-like coherence peak, which realizes higher dynamic range of reflectometry applications.

articleTitle: High-speed and broadband electro-optic silicon switch with submilliwatt switching power
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a 2×2 silicon electro-optic switch with a submilliwatt switching power (0.6 mW), a broad bandwidth (60 nm), and ultrafast speed (6 ns). Free-carrier injection Mach-Zehnder interferometers are employed.

articleTitle: Complete mitigation of brillouin scattering effects in reflective passive optical networks using triple-format OFDM radio signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Brillouin scattering is identified as a severe limitation in narrow line-width, bi-directional reflective systems. A spectrum management mitigation technique for triple-format OFDM signals is demonstrated over 15 km passive optical network using reflective electro-absorption transceivers.

articleTitle: QPSK phase and amplitude regeneration at 56 Gbaud in a novel idler-free non-degenerate phase sensitive amplifier
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce a novel input-idler-free non-degenerate phase sensitive amplifier (PSA) configuration and use it for simultaneous phase and amplitude regeneration of quadrature phase shift keyed (QPSK) signals demonstrated at symbol rates up to 56 Gbaud.

articleTitle: Broadband wavelength conversion with S/C/L-band flexible operation using cross-gain-modulation in a single quantum dot SOA
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated operating original and converted wavelengths flexible wavelength conversion using cross-gain-modulation in a single quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifier with covering the entire S-, C-, and L-bands.

articleTitle: Phase modulated optical millimeter wave generation based on externally injected gain switched laser
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel, simple, and cost effective set up for generating phase modulated millimeter-waves is experimentally demonstrated by using an externally injected gain switched laser. System performance has been investigated for 2.5Gbps downstream data.

articleTitle: Comparison of two CS-SSB modulators used in bidirectional carrier distributed long-reach passive optical network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Two different CS-SSB modulators based on Mach-Zehnder structure used in carrier-distributed long-reach passive optical networks are investigated and compared. The Rayleigh-backscattering beat noise tolerance and transmission performance are also discussed.

articleTitle: 160-to-40Gibt/s time demultiplexing in a low dispersion lead-silicate W-index profile fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 2.2m long sample of lead-silicate W-index profile fiber with nonlinear coefficient of 820W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>1km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>1 and exhibiting low and flat dispersion across the C-band is used in an all-optical 160-to-40Gbit/s demultiplexing scheme based on four-wave-mixing.

articleTitle: Reduced-guard-interval CO-OFDM with overlapped frequency-domain CD and PMD equalization
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an algorithm for CO-OFDM receivers to perform overlapped frequency-domain CD and PMD equalization before OFDM symbol demodulation. This approach enables OFDM transmission with a small cyclic prefix overhead of only 0.08%, and can enlarge the frequency averaging length for channel estimation in the presence of high PMD.

articleTitle: Over-sampling based burst-mode CDR technology for high-speed TDM-PON systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review recent progress of a over-sampling based burst-mode CDR as the key PMD device for supporting next-generation, 10 Gbps capable TDM-PON systems. For the essence of circuit design, its burst-mode sync time and pulse-width distortion tolerance are also presented.

articleTitle: Precise spectral and impulse response characterization of broadband Super Structured FBGs by multi-scan OSSB
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband optical single side band (OSSB) measurement by merging multiple RF scans. We provide a chip by chip optical phase measurements on a Super Structured FBG designed for Coherent DS-OCDMA.

articleTitle: Digital multi-rate receiver for 10GE-PON and GE-PON coexistence
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an NRZ multi-rate digital receiver capable of receiving upstream TDM traffic line-rates from GE-PON to 10GE-PON, that utilizes a simple optical front end and polyphase DSP at 2 samples per bit.

articleTitle: Optical interconnects for high performance computing
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: optical interconnect; high performance computing; optical links; optical switching; VCSEL; and Si photonics.

articleTitle: 100G - Key technology enablers of 100Gbit/s in carrier networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The demand for increased bandwidth is ever present. This paper reviews the attributes of coherent systems in light of the challenges faced by system designers to realize 100 Gb/s optical transmission systems.

articleTitle: Benefits of limited context awareness in stateless PCE
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A temporary resource reservation mechanism can enhance the performance of a stateless PCE in situations when the TED might not be up-to-date. This paper examines the benefits of such a mechanism by means of simulation.

articleTitle: Photonic mircocells based on hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the recent progress on hollow-core photonic crystal fibers and its integrated form of photonic microcells in both their design and fabrication and in their applications for coherent optics, Raman comb generation and laser metrology.

articleTitle: The non-wireless part of cellular networks: What's with the backhaul?
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The wireline backhaul of cellular networks plays a critical role in connecting cells to the rest of the telecom world and to each other. As the radio and air interfaces have evolved, so too has the backhaul. The architectures and transport technologies used for wireless backhaul in the US will be described.

articleTitle: Parametric amplification of 28-GBd NRZ-16QAM signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show experimentally parametric amplification of 28-GBd NRZ-16QAM signals with 11 dB polarization-dependent on-off gain and negligible OSNR penalty by using a high-power, low-noise DFB pump laser.

articleTitle: Power-efficient photonic BPSK coded ultrawideband signal generation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a power-efficient BPSK coded ultrawideband (UWB) signal generator. The 2.5 Gb/s BPSK coded signal is achieved through optical switching based on two intensity modulators driven by complementary microwave signals.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characteristics of Cr-doped fibers employing powder-in-tube technique
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The fabrication of Cr-doped fibers (CDFs) using fiber drawing-tower combined with non-silica powder-in-tube (PIT) technique to achieve the active application of chromium ions in fiber is demonstrated for the first time. The fluorescence enhancement, transmission loss, and few-mode operation are discussed in the paper. The success in fabrication of CDFs with PIT method may open the possibility for utilizing CDFs as broadband fiber light source.

articleTitle: Demonstration of wavelength agile metro node using reflective colorless components
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A fully reconfigurable add/drop node for use in metro DWDM networks based on a novel switched reflective architecture is demonstrated. The scheme saves power and avoids the need for expensive tunable lasers on equipment cards.

articleTitle: Impact of RF noise on transmission performance of multiband OFDM UWB over fiber systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the performance of multiband OFDM ultra wideband (UWB) signal over fiber system considering the impact of RF noise. A compensation technique is proposed to reduce RF noise impact.

articleTitle: Engineering fiber-nonlinearity based entangled photon sources for quantum key distribution applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We model fiber parametric entangled photon sources for use in quantum key distribution applications. Effects of Raman scattered photons are evaluated and are found to be manageable when appropriately detuned optical filters are employed.

articleTitle: Remote measurement method for transmission characteristics of access network fibers with coherent MPI
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A Novel technique to measure the transmission characteristics of access network fibers is proposed. The spectral losses including effects of coherent MPI are also estimated using PON architecture of short SMF and BIF.

articleTitle: Photonics for HPEC: A low-powered solution for high bandwidth applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Photonics offer high bandwidth for minimal power. While critical for the future of HPC, this has an immediate impact in HPEC, where power is critical. Here, a 4-10x improvement in performance/watt can be demonstrated.

articleTitle: FPGA verification of a single QC-LDPC code for 100 Gb/s optical systems without error floor down to BER of 10−15
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present FPGA-based emulation results of a single QC-LDPC code with 20% redundancy designed for applications in 100 Gb/s optical transmission systems. Error floor-free transmission can be achieved at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> with a Q factor of 5.9 dB.

articleTitle: 640Gbit/s reconfigurable OTDM add-drop multiplexer
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 640Gbit/s reconfigurable OTDM add/drop multiplexer is demonstrated, using a single periodically-poled Lithium-Niobate waveguide in a counter-propagating configuration. Error free operations confirm the effectiveness of a single device for simultaneous add/drop operations.

articleTitle: Implementing high [> 2048] split ratios in any PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical and electronic techniques eliminate the 10·log(N) upstream optical penalty inherent in 1×N optical splitters. With appropriate physical-layer hardware, any standards-based PON supports N >; 2048. A 1×2048 10G-PON illustrates physical limits and scalability.

articleTitle: Demonstration of record sensitivity in an optically pre-amplified receiver by combining PDM-QPSK and 16-PPM with pilot-assisted digital coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a power-efficient modulation/detection scheme that combines PDM-QPSK and 16-ary-pulse-position-modulation. A record sensitivity of 3.5 photons per bit at BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> is experimentally demonstrated at 2.5 Gb/s with digital coherent-detection, outperforming PDM-QPSK by >;3 dB.

articleTitle: Upstream Multi-Wavelength Shared PON with wavelength-tunable self-seeding Fabry-Perot Laser Diode
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed a Upstream Multi-Wavelength Shared PON using a tunable self-seeding FP-LD at ONU. The fiber laser performances are experimentally investigated. The paper also for the first time studies the effect of channel switch latency on the DBA with the IPACT scheme.

articleTitle: Spectrum efficient super-channels in dynamic flexible grid networks - A blocking analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze the blocking performance of spectrum efficient super-channels in dynamic flexible grid networks. Results demonstrate that increased spectral efficiency and flexible super-channel assignment do translate into network efficiency gains.

articleTitle: Recent progress on 2-micron fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Highly Tm-doped silicate glasses and fibers were developed, which exhibit a high slope efficiency of 68.3% and a gain per unit length of greater than 2dB/cm. Single frequency fiber lasers with laser linewidth less than 3kHz, Q-switched single frequency fiber lasers, and mode-locked fiber lasers near 2 micron wavelength were demonstrated using this newly developed fiber.

articleTitle: Optical interface platform for DRAM integration
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new bulk-Si optical platform for the optical interfaces toward DRAM integration with localized SOI structure and SPE. The demonstration shows that the waveguide and coupling loss are -0.61dB/mm and -2.6dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Manufacturable monolithically integrated InP dual-port coherent receiver for 100G PDM-QPSK applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a single-chip InP coherent receiver for detection of PDM-QPSK signals, which meets specifications for 100G between 1530 and 1570 nm. Integration includes a mode converter for efficient coupling from an SMF array.

articleTitle: Interplay between PMD and nonlinearity in 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission with co-propagating 10.7 Gb/s NRZ channels
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate interplay between PMD and nonlinearity in 112 Gb/s DP-QPSK signal transmission with 10.7 Gb/s NRZ neighbors can have both positive and negative impact depending on channel spacing and fiber launched power.

articleTitle: Optical networking trends and evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Control-plane enabled 100G transmission over a flexible optical layer is becoming a commercial reality in optical core networks. This paper discusses the drivers and challenges as well as future trends and further developments.

articleTitle: Propagation characteristics of seven-core fiber for spatial and wavelength division multiplexed 10-Gbit/s channels
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Propagation characteristics of seven-core fiber were investigated for multiplexed signals of spatial-division and wavelength-division. Effect of chromatic dispersion and inter-core crosstalk were evaluated for 5-km fiber by using 10-Gbit/s channels.

articleTitle: Space-, wavelength-, polarization-division multiplexed transmission of 56-Tb/s over a 76.8-km seven-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of space-division-multiplexed DWDM transmission of PDM-QPSK channels over a multicore fiber. A total capacity of 56-Tb/s (7×80×107-Gb/s) is transmitted over a 76.8-km seven-core-fiber with a record spectral-efficiency of 14-b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Comparison of pulse shapes in a 224Gbit/s (28Gbaud) PDM-QAM16 long-haul transmission experiment
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the effectiveness of RZ50 versus NRZ in a 224Gbit/s PDM-QAM16 transmission. Record distances of 2000km and 1520km are reported for single- and 3-channel transmission over SMF links with EDFAs-only amplification.

articleTitle: Impact of alfa-factor on SOA dynamic range for 20 GBd BPSK, QPSK and 16-QAM Signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Impact of SOA α-factor on dynamic range limitation decreases for higher-order modulation formats leading to undistinguishable performances of bulk and QD SOAs. Results are supported by experiments at 20 GBd BPSK, QPSK and 16-QAM.

articleTitle: Silicon electro-optic 4×4 non-blocking switch array for on-chip photonic networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Silicon 4×4 switch array based on carrier-injection for switching of multiple 40 Gbps WDM channels is reported. Operation in all 9 unique switch states and 12 possible I/O routings is verified with crosstalk less than 10 dB.

PACS Terms: (060.4250) Fiber optics and optical communications: Networks

articleTitle: Frequency-domain equalization for coherent optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Frequency-domain equalization (FDE) has been attracting much attention for high-speed long-haul transmission over fiber-optic channels. Two FDE configurations for coherent optical transmission are presented and some applications are also described.

articleTitle: Pulsating master and injected slave weak-resonant-cavity laser diodes based quasi-color-free 2.5Gb/s RZ DWDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The 25-km bi-directional 2.5Gb/s pulsed-RZ transmission in a quasi-color-free DWDM-PON with down- and up-stream slave weak-resonant-cavity Fabry-Perot laser diodes (WRC-FPLDs) coherently injection-locking and pulsating by a gain-switched master WRC-FPLD after 200-GHz AWG channelization is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 400 Gb/s optical packet switching node design with coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate how to realize 400 Gb/s optical packet switching for the first time. The key functions of optical packet generation, label separation, colorless O-OFDM payload detection and wavelength conversion are realized.

articleTitle: CMOS-compatible scalable photonic switch architecture using 3D-integrated deposited silicon materials for high-performance data center networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel fully-integrated scalable photonic switch architecture for data center networks, sustaining nonblocking 256×256 port size with nanosecond-scale switching times, interconnecting 2,560 server racks with 51.2-Tb/s bisection bandwidth.

articleTitle: Energy efficient optical access network technologies
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper summarizes recent technologies for reducing the power consumption of optical access networks and discusses trends in network evolution focusing on energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Influence of broadcast traffic on energy efficiency of long-reach SARDANA access network
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe reach extension in SARDANA TDM/WDM PON and show that energy efficiency of SARDANA increases when increasing the amount of broadcast traffic. 10G point-to-point optical access networks provide low efficiency for limited uplink capacity.

articleTitle: Modulation-format-free bias control technique for MZ modulator based on differential phasor monitor
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel bias control technique based on the differential phasor monitor for the LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> modulator. For demonstrations, the proposed bias control technique was used for 20-Gb/s QPSK and 43-Gb/s 16-QAM signals.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of low-cost VCSEL-intensity modulated end-to-end real-time optical OFDM signal transmission at 11.25Gb/s over 25km SSMFs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low-cost, narrow modulation bandwidth, un-cooled VCSELs can be utilized to directly modulate 64-QAM-encoded 11.25Gb/s signals for end-to-end real-time optical OFDM transmission over 25km SSMF IMDD systems with excellent performance robustness.

articleTitle: OTDM-WDM conversion based on Time-Domain Optical Fourier Transformation with spectral compression
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a scheme enabling direct serial-to-parallel conversion of OTDM data tributaries onto a WDM grid, based on optical Fourier transformation with spectral compression. Demonstrations on 320 Gbit/s and 640 Gbit/s OTDM data are shown.

articleTitle: InP-based comb generator for optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new InP-based comb generator for optical OFDM transmission. The device integrates a Mach-Zehnder modulator inside an amplified ring. We demonstrate a 6-line frequency comb which is tunable in wavelength and spacing.

articleTitle: 101.5 Gbit/s real-time OFDM transmitter with 16QAM modulated subcarriers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a 101.5 Gbit/s single-polarization OFDM transmitter based on real-time FPGA processing. We modulate 58 subcarriers with 16QAM.

articleTitle: Beyond 2.5Gb/s photonic generation and wireless transmission of different pulse modulation formats for a high speed impulse radio UWB over fiber system
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate beyond 2.5 Gbps photonic generation of different pulse modulation formats for impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) over fiber application. IR-UWB transmission over 20 km fiber and 0.25 m wireless link without any compensation is also presented.

articleTitle: CMOS Integrated Nanophotonics — enabling technology for exascale computing systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: CMOS Integrated Nanophotonics allows ultra-dense monolithic single-chip integration of optical and electrical functions. This technology can enable future Exaflops supercomputers by connecting racks, modules, and chips together with ultra-low power massively parallel optical interconnects.

articleTitle: New ground-to-train high-speed free-space optical communication system with fast handover mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a new ground-to-train free-space optical communication system that performs stable high-speed communication even when a train is running at high speed and does fast handover between laser transceivers on the ground.

articleTitle: 40G RZ-DQPSK transmitter monolithically integrated with tunable DFB laser array and Mach-Zehnder modulators
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 40G RZ-DQPSK transmitter monolithically integrated with a tunable DFB laser array and Mach-Zehnder modulators was developed for the first time. The optical waveform of 40Gb/s DQPSK was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: First experimental demonstration of nonbinary LDPC-coded modulation suitable for high-speed optical communications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The first experimental demonstration of nonbinary-LDPC-coded optical transmission is presented. Using DQPSK, we can achieve >;8dB and ~10dB net coding gains at the BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> in the absence and presence of I/Q imbalance, respectively.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of a low-loss nano-scale Si hybrid plasmonic waveguide
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel hybrid plasmonic waveguide with nano-scale confinement, consisting of a metal layer separated from a SOI nano-rib by a thin silica layer has been realized. The loss of 0.01dB/µm allows for ultra-high density photonic integration.

articleTitle: High capacity (64 × 43 Gb/s) unrepeatered transmission over 440 km
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a 64 × 43 Gb/s unrepeatered transmission experiment over 440 km of ultra-low loss fiber with third-order Raman pumping. We then compare coherent transmission at 40 Gb/s and 100 Gb/s in unrepeatered conditions.

articleTitle: Availability-aware SRLG failure protection in survivable WDM mesh networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With the increase of SRLGs, availability of shared-path protection deteriorates significantly. We propose availability-aware SRLG failure protection and heuristics by satisfying availability requirements while minimizing spare capacity usage.

articleTitle: Experimenting with immediate re-routing on an information-diffusion-based routing test-bed
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an immediate re-routing (IRR) extension to RSVP-TE signaling and implement it on our IDBR test-bed. By allowing wavelength conversion during the re-routing process, the proposed scheme can significantly reduce signaling induced blocking.

articleTitle: Optical home network based on an N×N multimode fiber architecture and CWDM technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With this optical home network solution associating an N×N multimode architecture and CWDM technology, various applications and network topologies are supported by a unique multiformat infrastructure. Issues related to the use of MMF are discussed.

articleTitle: Soft-decision forward error correction in a 40-nm ASIC for 100-Gbps OTN applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Soft-decision forward error correction provides high coding gain, but typically with high complexity. We present a soft-decision turbo product code with >11 dB NECG and reasonable complexity in a 40-nm ASIC for 100-Gbps applications.

articleTitle: A bidirectional 2×2 photonic network building-block for high-performance data centers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The design of a unique bidirectional 2×2 SOA-based optical switch is detailed and experimentally validated. Error-free operation and routing correctness is verified for 4×10Gb/s pseudorandom messages.

articleTitle: Effective accommodation for users located in long / short distance areas through PONs with dual stage splitter configuration using ALC burst-mode optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An ALC circuit that comprises our burst-mode optical amplifier suppresses the ASE noise in the time slots assigned to short-distance area and provides effective coexistence between long and short distance areas over a single OLT.

articleTitle: Single wavelength channel 10.2 Tb/s TDM-data capacity using 16-QAM and coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a serial 10.2-Tb/s transmission-system using a 1.28-TBd RZ-16-QAM signal, polarization multiplexing and ultra-fast coherent demultiplexing. Considering FEC-overhead, we achieve a record error-free net data rate of 9.5-Tb/s and transmission over 29-km.

articleTitle: Specialty fiber evaluation for in-building distribution of multiple-format OFDM radio signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical fiber options for deployment within the home environment were investigated for distribution of triple-play services. Corning ClearCurve® ZBL single-mode bend-insensitive optical fiber permits installation over 200 m reach compared to 50 m with plastic multi-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Carrier recovery and equalization for photonic-wireless links with capacities up to 40 Gb/s in 75–110 GHz band
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel robust digital carrier phase/frequency recovery structure is experimentally demonstrated for single carrier and multi-carrier, up to 40Gb/s, photonic-wireless links in 75–110 GHz band. We show that nonlinear equalization also improves system performance

articleTitle: Cascade laser power converter for simultaneous 10 Gbps data detection and efficient optical-to-electrical DC power generation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel device; cascade high-speed laser power converter. Error-free 10 Gbit/sec data detection and 21.1% optical-to-electrical DC power generation efficiency can be achieved simultaneously at 850nm wavelength and +1V voltage.

articleTitle: Agile subsystems for coherent systems beyond 100G
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Today's transponder technologies are changing the way that we look at photonic components

articleTitle: Metrology of complex optical modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This presentation offers a collection of slides covering the following topics: binary OOK modulation format; transmitter; receiver; transmission link; DSP algorithm; and performance monitoring.

articleTitle: Demonstration of world-first 103 Gbit/s transmission over 40 km single mode fiber by 1310 nm LAN-WDM optical transceiver for 100GbE
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 4 ch × 25.8 Gbit/s WDM transmission over 40 km single mode fiber was demonstrated. Minimum receiver sensitivity each lane after 40 km transmission was less than -26.0 dBm, proving the transceiver will meet IEEE 100GBASE-ER4 specifications.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s silicon modulator based on bulk-silicon platform for DRAM optical interface
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present 10Gb/s silicon Mach-Zehnder modulators fabricated on a bulk silicon wafer. 10Gb/s data transmission with extinction ratio of >9dB at de-emphasis level of 12dB is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: From coarse grid to mini-grid to gridless: How much can gridless help contentionless?
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study the benefit of gridless wavelength assignment. An efficient spectrum assignment algorithm is developed. It is found a mini-grid case with a certain grid granularity performs almost the same as the full gridless case.

articleTitle: Data transmission using wavelength-selective spatial routing for photonic interconnection networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Wavelength-selective spatial routing is proposed for photonic networks and demonstrated on an electro-optic microring switch. This technique yields greater path diversity in photonic networks, enabling improved overall network performance.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency in optical IP networks with multi-layer switching
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that significant savings in energy consumption can be achieved in optical IP networks with multi-layer switching by using a coordinated combination of IP aggregation, electronic bypass and optical bypass.

articleTitle: A survivable protection and restoration scheme using wavelength switching of integrated tunable optical transmitter for high throughput WDM-PON system
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A survivable protection and restoration mechanism is proposed using wavelength switching of low-cost integrated tunable laser assembly to protect multiple fiber failures in a high capacity colorless WDM-PON. This scheme does not require any expensive and complex opto-electronic space switching device for high throughput WDM-PON system.

articleTitle: Filtering tolerance of 108-Gb/s PolMux quadrature duobinary signal on 25-GHz grid
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the error-free transmission of 108-Gb/s PolMux quadrature duobinary signal in a 25-GHz spaced WDM system and investigate its tolerance to narrow optical filtering.

articleTitle: Characterization of semiconductor-laser phase noise with digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We develop a method of characterizing semiconductor-laser phase noise using a digital coherent receiver. The field spectrum, FM-noise spectrum, and phase-error variance can completely describe phase-noise characteristics.

articleTitle: Electronic phase conjugation for nonlinearity compensation in fiber communication systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Electronic phase conjugation is proposed for nonlinearity compensation in fiber communications. Coherent detection and I/Q modulation are used to implement phase conjugation. Significant performance improvement is achieved in WDM multi-rate systems.

articleTitle: Low-crosstalk and low-loss multi-core fiber utilizing fiber bend
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We designed and fabricated a multi-core fiber whose attenuation is less than 0.18 dB/km and effective area is about 80 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Crosstalk was observed be less than -55.5 dB after 17.6 km propagation.

articleTitle: Fully-integrated polarization-diversity coherent receiver module for 100G DP-QPSK
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new compact coherent receiver module comprising a micro-optic polarization beam splitter and two InP-based 90° hybrids with integrated photodiodes is characterized at 112 Gbit/s DP-QPSK. A penalty of only 1.3 dB in OSNR sensitivity at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> compared to theory was obtained at C-band wavelengths.

articleTitle: Wide-tuning (65 nm) Semi-cooled (50°C) operation of a tunable laser based on a novel widely tunable filter
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A tunable laser based on a medium wavelength selectivity tunable filter named a lateral-grating-assisted lateral-co-directional-coupler was developed. A wide tuning range of over 65 nm with SMSR of over 35 dB was demonstrated at 50°C.

articleTitle: Systems aspects of optical technologies for use in datacommunications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reviews the development of system techniques using advanced modulation formats that have arisen in recent years for use in data communications. Simulations are provided to allow comparison of the emerging schemes.

articleTitle: Multi-stage carrier phase recovery and nonlinear polarization crosstalk canceller for XPM mitigation
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel XPM mitigation technique by coordination of carrier phase recovery and nonlinear polarization crosstalk canceller is proposed. It doubles the Q improvement over conventional method in 112Gb/s DP-QPSK transmission over 1500km SMF link.

articleTitle: Photonic integrated circuits for optical routing and switching applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the latest advances in implementation of integrated photonic components required for optical routing and switching: tunable wavelength converters, mode-locked lasers, active optical switches and optical buffers.

PACS Terms: (060.1810) Buffers, couplers, routers, switches, and multiplexers

articleTitle: Compact and high-density opto-electronic transceiver module for chip-to-chip optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We fabricated an opto-electronic transceiver module on a flexible printed circuit board without using a lens array. 10Gbps data transmission through polynorbornene-based waveguide is achieved with low inter-channel cross talk.

articleTitle: An SLA-based energy-efficient scheduling scheme for EPON with sleep-mode ONU
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an SLA-based scheduling scheme for EPON in which OLT can adjust sleep time and ONU can quit sleep mode for sending expedited frames. Considerable energy can be saved under practical power consumption settings.

articleTitle: World-first experimental demonstration of synchronous clock recovery in an 11.25Gb/s real-time end-to-end optical OFDM system using directly modulated DFBs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple, highly-effective, DSP-free, optical OFDM(OOFDM) synchronous clock recovery technique preserving system performance and enhancing stability is proposed and experimentally demonstrated, for the first time, in real-time end-to-end, 11.25Gb/s 64-QAM OOFDM, directly-modulated-DFB-based, 25km IMDD systems.

articleTitle: Ultra-low-voltage micro-ring modulator integrated with a CMOS feed-forward equalization driver
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an all-CMOS micro-ring modulator packaged with a feed-forward equalization driver circuit, operating in charge-injection mode at 8 Gbps with a drive voltage of only 50 mVp-p and a power consumption of 1.8 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: All-optical 2R regeneration of BPSK and QPSK data using a 90° optical hybrid and integrated SOA-MZI wavelength converter pairs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical 2R regeneration with a 90° optical hybrid and integrated MZI-SOA pairs for 10 Gb/s BPSK and 20 Gb/s QPSK with negative power penalty. Power penalty and OSNR improvements of 7 dB and 5 dB are shown with additive ASE noise.

articleTitle: Scattered pilot channel tracking method for PDM-COOFDM transmissions using polar-based intra-symbol frequency-domain average
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated an efficient scattered pilot channel tracking approach with a new polar-based intra-symbol frequency domain average (ISFA) for 16-QAM, 40-Gb/s PDM-CO-OFDM systems. This proposal could promise an relatively stable performance even under an rapidly time-varying environment.

articleTitle: GMPLS/PCE/OBST architectures for guaranteed sub-wavelength mesh metro network services
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents three innovative GMPLS/PCE/OBST interworking archi-tectures for mesh metro networks which deliver guaranteed contention-free sub-wavelength services with enhanced channel utilization, yet enabling multi-technology interoperability.

articleTitle: Impact of crosstalk on MB-OFDM UWB transmission in radio over fiber WDM system
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the impact of crosstalk on the performance of MB-OFDM UWB signal transmission in RoF WDM system. It is found that OFDM signal's orthogonalities are almost kept after 20 km of fiber transmission even under adjacent channel crosstalk level of -5 dB. MB-OFDM UWB over fiber is robust to crosstalk from other channels.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive parametric tunable dispersion compensation for field fiber transmissions with ultra-high-definition video signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a parametric TDC employing polarization diversity loop with a PM-HNLF. Stable transmissions under the dispersion-managed condition over 105-km field fiber are demonstrated using NRZ-OOK ultra-high-definition video signals at 43-Gbit/s.

articleTitle: A review of past, present and future optical networks optics is driving structural change
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents a collection of slides covering the following topics: roadmap of wire line network technology; transmission networks; optical networks; fiber deployment; network economics; network topology; access network; core network; mobile network; network transformation; demarcation; market entry barriers; and USP.

articleTitle: Unaltered optical fiber as an absolute wavelength reference for OFDR systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel method of obtaining an absolute wavelength reference for OFDR measurements using Rayleigh backscatter from standard optical fiber. We report 1 GHz (8pm) accuracy.

articleTitle: Monolithic 100 Gb/s twin-IQ Mach-Zehnder modulators for advanced hybrid high-capacity transmitter boards
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Development and characterization of monolithic, flip-chip compatible 2×50 Gb/s twin-IQ DQPSK MZ modulator chips - capable for hybrid assembly onto planar optical boards of advanced Tbit-capacity transmitter modules - is reported for the first time.

articleTitle: 320 Gb/s RZ-DPSK data multicasting in self seeded parametric mixer
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report first experimental demonstration of 320Gb/s RZ-DPSK wavelength multicasting in self-seeded parametric mixer free of Brillouin backscatter. High efficiency multicaster operated without pump phase dithering for error free wavelength mapping of phase-coded channel.

articleTitle: 100G transoceanic length transmission with high spectral efficiency using bandwidth constrained PDM-QPSK
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review our recent 100G, high spectral efficiency, transmission experiments over transoceanic and regional distances. Transmitter pre-filtering together with a MAP detection algorithm can significantly improve spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Non-data-aided wide-range frequency offset estimator for QAM optical coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel blind frequency offset estimator for coherent quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) receivers. Its frequency offset estimation range is more than three times the conventional estimation range.

articleTitle: 25-Gb/s transmitter for optical interconnection with 10-Gb/s VCSEL using dual peak-tunable pre-emphasis
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a 25-Gb/s VCSEL transmitter with 10-Gb/s VCSEL. By driving standard 10-Gb/s VCSELs using pre-emphasis technology to overcome their optical bandwidth limit, we achieved clear eye opening at 25 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Flexible and grid-less wavelength selective switch using LCOS technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The increasing spectral efficiency of Optical Transmission systems is constrained by the limitations of wavelength switching and is driving a requirement for significantly more flexible approaches to routing of the optical traffic. We present the intrinsic Grid-free capabilities of LCOS and show how it can be used practically in a flexible Grid architecture to maximize total fiber capacity.

articleTitle: Transport networks at a crossroads
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Traffic in backbone networks continues to grow at rapid pace. The bulk of this growth comes from low revenue internet traffic. Naturally, this raises interest in lowering the costs of building and maintaining the transport network. It is here that some make the case for OTN switching as low-cost alternative to IP/MPLS core networks. To compare and contrast the costs of OTN versus MPLS, we undertook multiple modeling exercises. The preliminary results show that the optimal network design depends on different parameters, such as: ratio of peak to average flow demands, number of simultaneous peak demands, ratio of MPLS to OTN port costs and size of core transport interconnects. We review our model, assumptions and outcome, and highlight the impact on product and network architecture.

articleTitle: Parallel WDM regenerative waveform conversion for mixed NRZ and RZ transmission networks using a SOA-based multiple switching-window optical gate
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate parallel regenerative waveform conversion with tunable pulsewidths using SOA-based multiple switching-window optical-gate (MW-OG). MW-OG based inline regenerations improve performance of a mixed NRZ/RZ transmission network.

articleTitle: SOA-based OTDM-DPSK demultiplexing assisted by offset-filtering
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated for the first time 80 to 40 Gb/s OTDM-DPSK demultiplexing using a single SOA assisted by offset-filtering. Error free performance is achieved with an average power penalty of 5.5 dB.

articleTitle: Line coding for downlink DML modulation in λ-shared, RSOA-based asymmetric bidirectional WDM PONs
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the use of various DC-balanced line codes for downlink modulation in single-fiber, wavelength-shared WDM-PON systems which employ 10-Gbps directly modulated lasers and 2.5-Gbps reflective semiconductor optical amplifiers for downlink and uplink, respectively.

articleTitle: Low computation complexity two-stage feedforward carrier recovery algorithm for M-QAM
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a modified two-stage feedforward carrier recovery algorithm for M-QAM formats that achieves a 3× reduction in computation complexity compared to a single-stage algorithm. When combining with a feedback loop, 5.3-10× computation complexity reduction can be achieved.

articleTitle: Hybrid 2.5G/10G co-existing OFDMA-PON employing single receiver at the OLT
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 2.5G/10G co-existing OFDMA-PON is demonstrated through 20km SSMF with 31dB loss budget. Only one receiver at the OLT and low-speed transceiver at the 2.5G ONUs are required, thereby reducing system complexity and cost.

articleTitle: Silicon chip based wavelength conversion of ultra-high repetition rate data signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on all-optical wavelength conversion of 160, 320 and 640 Gbit/s line-rate data signals using four-wave mixing in a 3.6 mm long silicon waveguide. Bit error rate measurements validate the performance within FEC limits.

articleTitle: State of the short-reach optics market
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper gives an overview of the opportunities for components suppliers in the short-reach optics market. It covers Gigabit through 100G topics as well as optical interconnects technologies. Overall forecasts will be discussed.

articleTitle: Soft glass based large mode area photonic bandgap fibre for mid-infrared applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-solid LMA Bragg fibre (mode area exceeding 1100 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) is presented for mid-infrared applications, based on a new design strategy that induces large differential loss between fundamental and higher order modes for effective single-mode operation.

articleTitle: Integrated-optic demultiplexers for optical OFDM signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review recent progress on our integrated-optic OFDM demultiplexers fabricated with silica PLC technology. We detail the configuration, operating principle, and characteristics of the demultiplexers, which are based on optical FFT and DFT.

articleTitle: Energy-efficiency study of optical OFDM in data centers
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a study on the energy efficiency of adaptive optical OFDM in data center's networks. The DSP architecture of the proposed scheme is targeted to an FPGA and achieves more than 70% lower energy consumption compared to conventional OFDM modulation.

articleTitle: Nine-way optical wavelength multicasting and field trail transmission over optical network test-bed (JGN2Plus)
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 1-to-9 optical wavelength multicasting, based on dualpump four-wave mixing in highly-nonlinear fiber. A 100-km field trial experiment is also conducted to demonstrate the feasibility of optical wavelength multicasting.

articleTitle: Techno-economic study of high-splitting ratio PONs and comparison with conventional FTTH-PONs/FTTH-P2P/FTTB and FTTC deployments
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a techno-economic study on the outside plant costs comparison between the standard FTTH-PON deployments with future high-splitting ratio PONs. The high-splitting ratio PONs are also compared with other FTTx deployments.

articleTitle: Phase division analysis for intradyne coherent detection in nonlinear regime
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a phase division analysis method that adaptively moderates nonlinear distortion revealed in intradyne QAM receivers. The received signals are de-interleaved in accordance with recovered carrier phase; equalized with parallel DSP slices.

articleTitle: 320 Gb/s phase-transparent wavelength conversion in a silicon nanowire
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical wavelength conversion for a 320 Gb/s RZ-DPSK signal is demonstrated based on four wave mixing in a silicon nanowire. BER better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> is achieved for the wavelength converted RZ-DPSK signal.

articleTitle: Progress in soft-decision FEC
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss the practical implementation of LDPC codes in soft-decision FEC for 100 Gb/s digital coherent systems. The question of the definition of net coding gain for differential QPSK used to avoid cycle slip is raised.

articleTitle: Integration of photodetectors with lasers for optical interconnects using 200 mm waferscale III–V/SOI technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient photodetectors on top of a laser epitaxial structure completely fabricated using 200 mm wafer scale III–V/SOI technology enabling very dense integration of lasers and detectors for optical interconnect circuits.

articleTitle: 25 Gbps optical link for ultra-high-definition-television streaming
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose 25 Gbps optical link for uncompressed ultra-high-definition-television streaming and demonstrate it over 3 km single mode fiber employing low-cost and compact optical transmitter and receiver set.

articleTitle: SOA/REAM as vector modulator for QAM upstream
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Simultaneous encoding of information in the optical phase and amplitude for upstream transmission is demonstrated with an integrated SOA/REAM of small form factor. The crosstalk penalties between the QAM tributaries are assessed and discussed.

articleTitle: MIMO system capacity improvements using radio-over-fibre distributed antenna system technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The effect of antenna separation in a 3×3 MIMO system using RoF DAS technology is investigated. Larger antenna separation is found to improve the throughput due to reduced channel correlation and improved SNR.

articleTitle: Ultrawidely tunable single-mode fiber acousto-optic filter
publicationTitle: 2011 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A single-mode fiber (SMF) acousto-optic tunable filter (AOTF) with a wide tuning range of 300 nm is demonstrated. The SMF used here has six air holes in the cladding region that causes a larger difference between higher-order modes' indices compared to those of a conventional SMF. A single resonance peak for the coupling to the first higher-order modes is appeared in the transmission spectrum of SMF AOTF over the wavelength range 1.3–1.6 µm.
